name: Rating
label: Rating
description: Star-scale rating or a thumbs up and down verdict, with keyboard selection and a read-only mode.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial rating for uncontrolled use. 0 means no rating.

props.name: max
props.description: Number of steps on the scale

props.name: onValueChange
props.description:
Convenience callback receiving the new rating directly.
Fires on every selection, including a clear back to 0 via `allowClear`.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Display-only mode — renders the current rating with no interaction

props.name: allowClear
props.description: Selecting the already-selected step clears the rating back to 0

props.name: icon
props.description: Glyph drawn for each step — Material Symbol name (string) or custom element (ReactNode). A string glyph solidifies on filled steps via the font's fill axis; a custom element should draw with `currentColor` so the filled colour still reads.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the group, and the base of each step's label (in the `thumbs` form the group's name only; each thumb is named by `upLabel` or `downLabel`)

props.name: valueLabel
props.description:
The spoken value, given a step (or, in `readOnly` mode, the current
rating) and `max`. Defaults to "3 out of 5". It follows `label` and a
colon, as in "Rating: 3 out of 5".

props.name: variant
props.description:
The scale's form. `stars` (the default) is a row of `max` steps that
fill up to the value. `thumbs` is a two-way verdict, a thumb up and a
thumb down, for a quick "Was this helpful?": value 1 is up, 2 is down,
0 is no answer yet, and `max`, `icon` and `valueLabel` are ignored.

props.name: upLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the thumb up in the `thumbs` form.

props.name: downLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the thumb down in the `thumbs` form.

rows.text: Moves focus into the group at one option, and out of the group on the next press.
Moves to the next option and chooses it.
Moves to the previous option and chooses it.
Moves to the last option and chooses it.
Moves to the first option and chooses it.
